title: Hmm, am I suppose to add something else with it? Too soft.
text: Hmm, am I suppose to add something else with it? Too soft.. I usually use rice and this ash is soo soft that the incense just does not stay upright!  I am thinking of mixing this with rice, perhaps?  Very fine, but not functional.  I am a little disappointed.
